# File input

Attaches one file: the paperclip square, the label and the chosen name beside it.

- Status: implemented
- Category: input
- Pattern: HTML `<input type="file"> over the drawn square`
- Text style: `label` (`.nd-text-label`)

## Anatomy

- **square**: The native input, transparent over a drawn square with the paperclip.
- **label**: Upper-case label (kicker).
- **name** (optional): The chosen file, truncated.
- **hint** (optional): Allowed types and size.
- **remove** (optional): A button that clears the file.

## Variants

- `single`: One file.

## States

- `default`
- `hover`
- `focus-visible`
- `invalid`: Danger border on the square and a written error.
- `filled`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Enter, Space | Opens the file chooser. |

## Accessibility

- Role: button (native file input)
- Name: Its label.

WCAG 2.2 success criteria:

- 1.3.1 Info and Relationships (A)
- 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast (AA)
- 2.4.7 Focus Visible (AA)
- 2.4.13 Focus Appearance (AAA)
- 3.3.1 Error Identification (A)
- 3.3.2 Labels or Instructions (A)
- 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (A)

## Web example

From the reference page:

```html
<div class="nd-file">
  <div class="nd-file__row">
    <input
      class="nd-file__input"
      id="ex-file"
      type="file"
      aria-describedby="ex-file-hint"
    />
    <span class="nd-file__button" aria-hidden="true"
      ><svg
        class="nd-icon"
        viewBox="0 0 24 24"
        fill="none"
        aria-hidden="true"
        focusable="false"
      >
        <path
          d="M8 13l5-5a2 2 0 1 1 3 3l-6 6a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-5-5l6-6"
          stroke="currentColor"
          stroke-width="1.5"
          stroke-linecap="round"
        /></svg
    ></span>
    <span class="nd-file__text">
      <label class="nd-file__label" for="ex-file">Attach a file</label>
      <span class="nd-file__hint" id="ex-file-hint"
        >PDF or image, up to 10 MB.</span
      >
    </span>
  </div>
</div>
```
